question:
Select the most appropriate idiom to fill in the blank.

Jane, please don’t tell me fairy tales; I just want to know the real matter ________.
solution:
The correct answer is: **in a nutshell**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The idiom **"in a nutshell"** means to describe something very briefly, to summarize the main point in a concise manner. (संक्षेप में)

 
 
• **Example: **He explained the entire report in a nutshell during the meeting.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that the author asks Jane to skip the fairy tales and just give him the main point directly.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **in a nutshell.**
